title: Knowledge Note Bridge
user: Working self-learners who capture technical and business-domain knowledge in Markdown but need card updates without destroying existing review history.
smallest_useful_product: A local Markdown-to-Anki bridge with stable card IDs, a dry-run diff, explicit archive/rename handling, and a reversible history-preservation report.
success_measure: At least 90% of changed cards retain intended review history, with every destructive change previewed before sync.
constraints: Back up collections before writes; use AnkiConnect; never transmit notes or decks by default.
